f_b_3_6_NEW_finding.title: torch cublasLtMatmul bypasses CIPHER's cublasGemmEx GOT-patch
f_b_3_6_NEW_finding.description: Modern torch (2.11.0+cu130) defaults to cublasLtMatmul for fp32/tf32 matmul; CIPHER's substrate GOT-patches only cublasGemmEx (single cuBLAS target; cipher_rt_cublas_shim.c). To force the cublasGemmEx code path, this test set TORCH_CUBLASLT_DISABLE=1 + dtype=fp16 + allow_tf32=False. Under default torch settings, shim_calls=0 (substrate intact, mechanism healthy, just bypassed).
scope_implications: Gate A under default torch settings would FAIL (shim_calls=0)
Customer vLLM workloads using default torch hot path -> CIPHER's interception layer never fires; capability claims about cuBLAS routing/actuation don't fire either
Gate B + Gate C are downstream of Gate A; same bypass concern applies

remediation_candidates_for_anil_pick.description: Extend cipher_rt_cublas_shim to also intercept cublasLtMatmul + cublasLtMatmulInit + a few additional cuBLAS-Lt entry points. Substrate source addition; same pattern as existing cublasGemmEx shim. ~1-2 ED substrate work + Phase A regression re-run.
remediation_candidates_for_anil_pick.trade: Closes the gap for default torch hot path; v1 ships with broader cuBLAS coverage.

remediation_candidates_for_anil_pick.trade: Preserves Goal 5 verbatim (customer command unchanged). Side effect: may reduce torch performance on shapes where cublasLt would otherwise be faster than classic cuBLAS. Trade investigation needed.

f_b_3_6_NEW_finding.recommendation: Option 1 (substrate extension to cublasLt). v1 ships with broader cuBLAS coverage that matches torch's default hot path. ~1-2 ED additive substrate work. Not a v1.5 carry; the cuBLAS coverage gap would surface immediately on real customer workloads.
